Les propulseurs marins à entraînement circonférentiel constituent une alternative aux hélices classiques marines, en présentant plusieurs avantages : manoeuvrabilité, compacité, discrétion acoustique, amélioration de la traînée de la carène par l’absence de ligne d’arbre. Cependant, la présence d’une tuyère embarquant le moteur électrique d’entraînement pénalise le rendement. Une piste d’amélioration est d’adopter un propulseur à plusieurs étages à l’instar des moteurs d’avion, afin de regagner environ vingt points de rendement. La configuration même de l’entraînement extérieur, sans arbre, supprime la complexité mécanique rencontrée sur les hélices contrarotatives classiques.

Les difficultés sont de deux ordres. La mise ne eau dans une veine hydrodynamique est ainsi obligatoire. Par ailleurs, l’absence d’arbre d’entraînement empêche une mesure aisée du couple d’entraînement, valeur requise pour déterminer le rendement global du propulseur.

D’autre part, le principe des moteurs à plusieurs étages est de récupérer la puissance perdue par le premier étage, en redressant l’écoulement, un propulseur idéal accélérant l’écoulement uniquement de manière axiale. Un second objectif du projet consiste à caractériser cette récupération d’énergie opérée par les étages supérieurs.

    Le projet associe les compétences en modélisation de machines électriques de l’IRENav et les compétences en modélisation hydrodynamique de l’ENSTA-IRDL (UMR CNRS 6027) et de l’IRENav.  L’ENSTA met par ailleurs à disposition sa veine aérodynamique dédiée aux applications marines, et l’instrumentation associée. Ce projet s’inscrit dans un projet plus vaste financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (Projet AID RD-PROP), visant à proposer des méthodologies de modélisation et de conception de propulseurs électriques navals intégrés à entrainement circonférentiel.     About Papers

    Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

    Your portfolio includes:

    • Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

    • Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

    • Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

    As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

    Your role

    We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

    Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

    If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

    Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

    • 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

    • 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

    Core Responsibilities

    • Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

    • Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

    • Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

    • Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

    2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution

    • Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

    • Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

    3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA

    • Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

    • Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

    • Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

    • Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

    4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops

    • Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

    • Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

    • Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

    • Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

    What We Are Looking For

    Essential Experience & Qualifications

    • 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

    • Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

    • Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

    Mindset & Soft Skills

    • Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

    • Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

    Working Environment & Expectations

    • Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

    • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.

      • Power BI

    Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

    HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

    GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day.

    As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you.

    You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together.

    You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date.

    You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence.

    You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law.

    You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter.

    You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development.


    WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

    You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

    • You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years.

    • Strong experience in agentic AI.

    • You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

    • You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses.

    • You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough.

    • You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

    • You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs.

    • You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful.

    • Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

    WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

    On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

    About Us

    At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system.     This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

    You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

    • Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible.

    • Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements.

    This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

    This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

    Data Engineer

    Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them.

    Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet.

    You will build the foundation that fixes this.

    What you'll do

    • Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it.

    • Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production.

    • Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team.

    • Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent.

    • Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io.

    • Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today.

    • Treat the warehouse like a product. Keep documentation, lineage, and discoverability current so departments trust the data assets, and handle sensitive HR and workforce data to GDPR standards.

    What success looks like in your first 3–6 months

    • The warehouse has a real foundation. The first vertical slice, our accounts model, ships with tests and monitoring.

    • You fully own the Dataform transform layer, creating capacity for semantic modeling and business-definition work

    • Pipelines run against a defined freshness SLA, and you catch breaks before stakeholders do.

    • Documentation and lineage cover what you own, and datasets that were stuck now flow to the teams that need them.


    What we're looking for

    You have built warehouse foundations yourself. You designed them rather than maintaining someone else's, with a track record in:

    • Designing layered warehouse architectures (medallion, bronze-silver-gold) and dimensional models (star and snowflake) that teams reuse

    • Advanced SQL as your daily working language

    • Hands-on BigQuery, since our stack is GCP

    • Building a SQL transform layer in Dataform, or strong dbt experience.

    • ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads and real orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management

    • Data quality, testing, freshness monitoring, and lineage built in from the start

    • Python for pipeline code, scripting, automation, and API integration

    • Reviewable, repeatable change through Git and PR-based deployment

    Nice to have, not required: another modern cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Redshift; managed ingestion such as Airbyte; preparing data for ML, LLM, and agentic use cases; and familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics and HR or workforce data. English is our working language, and Dutch is not required.

DACH Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation (m/f/d)

Position Summary: 

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to the VP of Global GTM. We are seeking an elite, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across top-tier accounts. Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world's most mission-critical ERP environments.

 

Key Responsibilities

Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. 

 

The SAP "Triple Threat": 

  1. Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles.
  2. SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects  to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations.
  3. GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations.

 

C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity).

 

Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base.

 

Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP's rigorous reporting standards.

 

Required Skills/Experience:

 

  • Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner).
  • Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
  • Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees.
  • Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP's regional field teams.
  • Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO.
  • Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required. 

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.Languages: Professional fluency in both German and English (written and spoken).

What You will get: 

  • You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, an attractive salary and extensive benefits (including JobRad, Focus Friday and much more).
  • You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.
  • We support our employees with 5 fully paid sick days per child and subsidize childcare up to primary school age.
  • In addition to an individual onboarding and buddy program, we offer comprehensive training opportunities and english language classes.
  • We offer 30 days of paid vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) for optimal work-life balance.
  • Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.
  • Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.
  • The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.

 

About Onapsis:

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

 

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world's leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM helps governments and financial institutions detect and disrupt illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to central banks, financial regulators and financial intelligence units across EMEA. You will own the relationships and the revenue in a territory where digital asset supervision is growing fast, setting account strategy and closing six- and seven-figure deals with institutions that have long, careful buying processes. What makes this seat unusual is the chance to shape how TRM serves supervisors as MiCA and the EU AML package reshape their work.

  • Map your territory’s central banks, supervisors and FIUs, using AI tools to identify budget holders, decision-makers, champions and regulatory triggers so your first outreach reaches the right person.

  • Build and maintain 3x qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, regional events and campaigns with Marketing, and measure what converts.

  • Navigate tenders, frameworks and call-offs with Solutions Architecture, Legal and Deal Desk, so each response is accurate and on time.

  • Grow live customers through renewals, expansion and referrals, using AI summaries of usage and call notes to spot expansion signals early.

  • Bring supervisory and customer insight back to Policy, Product and Marketing so the next release reflects how regulators in your region work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years selling SaaS, data intelligence or investigative solutions into central banks, financial regulators, FIUs or comparable government accounts in EMEA.

  • A record of closing six- and seven-figure deals and meeting quota across long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Existing relationships within EMEA central banks, supervisors or FIUs, and credibility with senior officials.

  • Working knowledge of MiCA, the EU AML framework and how public sector buyers procure.

  • Hands-on use of AI for account research, planning and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

  • Credible, clear communication with senior executives, in person and virtually, and a knack for storytelling.

  • Fluent English; additional European languages are a plus.

  • Based in France, Belgium, Spain, Netherlands, willingness to travel regularly across the region.

About the Team:

  • TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director real ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

  • The team is fast-paced, positive and collaborative, with shared pipeline insight and open sharing of what works.

  • The work is hard in a useful way: senior public sector buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a category that is new to many supervisors.

  • You will work with Partnerships, Legal, Marketing, Policy and Product, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you profile and stack-rank every central bank, regulator and FIU in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

  • When a regulator sends an urgent request late on a Friday for a same-day conversation and demo, you and TRM’s Solutions team make it happen that day.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: UK and CET core hours, with flexibility for occasional US-EMEA calls.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.

 

What you will do

  • Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture.

  • Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it.

  • Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading.

  • Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes.

  • Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters.

  • Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA.

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore.

 

In your first six months, you might

  • Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Lay out the target architecture and first steps for moving our transaction core off Salesforce.

  • Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them

     

What you bring

  • At least 8 years of experience building and running software in production, including systems where errors cost real money.

  • Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot.

  • A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title.

  • Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance.

  • Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • AI is part of your daily work. Experience building or evaluating AI agents in production is a strong plus.

  • Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus

 

Practical details

Description

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Build the checks, from raw quantum sensor signal to field map, that tell a trustworthy measurement from a measurement or reconstruction artifact, on lab and customer data alike.

  • Trace a failed check to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not.

  • Keep the catalogue of known artifacts and the set of reference measurements that make every new verdict faster and more defensible.

  • Validate the team's evaluation methods against simulation and reference measurements before they go into daily use.

  • Give our Applications Engineers and the team a clear verdict on each measurement, and feed what breaks back into the next generation of the QDm.

 

What is expected of you

  • 3+ years of professional experience outside academia applying data science to measurement or imaging data from physical instruments.

  • A degree in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics or a related discipline; a PhD is welcome, not required.

  • Solid statistics and signal or image processing: you ask where a signal comes from, tell it from noise and systematics, and show it with numbers.

  • Fluency in Python and the scientific stack, with version control and tests as a habit.

  • AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

  • Comfortable operating our systems in the lab when your analysis needs data.

  • Fluent English; German is an advantage, not a requirement. On-site in Munich.

Experience with magnetic or electromagnetic measurements or semiconductor failure analysis is a plus. What we cannot teach on the job is rigor with real measurement data and the habit of turning one analysis into a method the team can reuse, and that is exactly what we want you to bring.

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

  • Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. 

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. 

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market. 

  • Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers.

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. About the role

We're looking for a Brand Marketing Lead to join our Brand & Marketing team at Pleo. What you’ll be doing

  • Own the brand marketing strategy that moves Pleo from ‘one of many’ to the undisputed choice for mid-market European finance leaders.

  • Build and execute integrated brand campaigns from concept through to reporting — learning from what we’ve just launched, and pushing further.

  • Create branded content that shows how financial services should be done. Content that recognizes the precision, rigor, and craft that finance leaders bring to their work.

  • Manage the funnel strategically — balancing awareness, consideration, and conversion. Not just fishing in the pond of people who already know us, but earning the right to speak to people we don’t know yet.

  • Own your budget and agency relationships — you’re the strategic partner they answer to.

  • Measure what matters — working with Brand Intelligence, Integrated Marketing, Data, and MOps to track brand lift, earned media, consideration, and how brand work flows into pipeline and revenue.

  • Set the benchmark for brand work in fintech — prove that category-defining campaigns come from strategic rigor and creative excellence working together. You’ll establish Pleo as the model for how brands should think about their audience, and show that understanding someone better than anyone else is a more powerful differentiator than any feature.

What you bring

  • A portfolio of work that shows you’ve led campaigns from strategy through to execution — ideally integrated campaigns that work across multiple channels

  • Strong stakeholder management skills — you can influence a room, sell an idea, and push back when something isn’t working

  • Strategic thinking + execution mindset — you’re equally comfortable building a 6-month brand strategy and getting your hands dirty on day-to-day campaign work

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace — this is a growing company, and things move fast. You thrive in that

  • Understanding of how brand and pipeline connect — you know that brand campaigns need to serve business growth, not just awareness

  • A point of view on category dynamics — you can look at a market and spot where everyone’s getting it wrong

  • A strong understanding for when/how to localise concepts, messaging & GTM campaigns across different markets.

  • Fluency in one or more of our European markets is a bonus (not required, but helpful)

Why is this role a good fit for you

  • You want to reframe an entire category's conversation by competing on human insight rather than just feature parity.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment where you can build campaigns that serve as a 5-year foundation.

  • You believe brand strategy must be grounded in audience understanding and directly drive business outcomes.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer purely high-level strategy without getting hands-on with day-to-day campaign execution.

  • You operate best in rigid, highly structured environments with slow moving pace and minimal ambiguity.

  • You view brand marketing in isolation from performance data, pipeline metrics, and commercial growth.

  • Map customer journeys across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise segments to identify brand opportunities.

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Why this role, why now

12,000+ companies trust Perk with their travel and spend, and we've brought both together in one intelligent platform. Every booking, expense and invoice adds to a wealth of data at your fingertips, and now is the moment to enable teams to use this data intelligently to power better decisions, precise reporting, and to create cost and time savings for our customers. Come lead the team that makes all of this possible.

The Role

Data is at the core of Perk's innovation and the backbone of how we will evolve our products using new technology. As our VP of Data, you'll step into one of the most influential leadership roles in Builders (Data, Product, Design, Engineering) with a direct hand in shaping Perk's strategy and success, and we scale our multi product platform.

Reporting to our President of Product and Technology, you'll lead a 40+ person organisation, with a remit that spans our Travel, Spend, and Events products. This role also spans our core functions and drives the business, including Customer Care, Marketing, Finance, Revenue and People. You'll join a strong, talented team with a clear mandate to shape how we create exceptional products at Perk, using our proprietary data.

Across travel, spend, and events, Perk holds a wealth of data that touches every booking, expense, invoice and payment. Your opportunity is to reshape it so it powers smarter, more intelligent products that keep us on the cutting edge of what is possible.

This is a role for a data leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, scales high-performing organisations through senior leaders, and has the technical credibility to go deep when it matters. You'll join a top-notch leadership team where we elevate each other, build shared strategies and win together. You'll help define how we grow and make decisions, with accountability for data across the whole company.

Your team

You’ll lead a talented, collaborative and innovative team who are excellent at what they do. They span seven crafts: Data Product Partners, Reporting Analytics, Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science and Data Governance. Together they power the work the business relies on every day, and they’re ready to take data to its next stage of scale with you.

Your missions

  1. Strategy and Roadmap. More than ever data informs everything we do and is core to the AI native products that we build. You’ll own the long term vision and strategy for data architecture, analytics, predictive modeling, and AI product integration. Work hand in hand with Product, Engineering and Platform teams across Perk to turn machine learning and advanced analytics into products customers love.

  2. Set the standard for trust. Own data governance, privacy and compliance, so security and regulatory requirements are built in from the start. Partner with our AI leadership to make sure the data behind every AI product is trusted, so everything we build earns customer confidence.

  3. Build a data platform we rely on. Run data infrastructure like a flagship product: governed, reliable, built for scale from day one. You own the budget and the build, buy and prioritisation calls.

  4. Lead with conviction. Unify the craft, standards and roadmap across teams so data speaks with one voice, and anticipates questions before they're asked. Be the data voice alongside Product, Engineering, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Revenue and People.

  5. Grow leaders who grow the business. Coach your senior leaders, shape the operating model and org design, attract top talent, and build a culture of ownership, autonomy and measurable results.

What success looks like

  • Data is the foundation of products that know our customers and anticipate what they need: personalised experiences, smarter recommendations and proactive insights, so they get answers before they have to ask.

  • You've built a high-performing, trusted data organisation that delivers measurable value across the business so all functions use and trust the data to shape decisions, inform strategy and change how we work, well beyond reporting.

  • Your teams operate with clear priorities, solid infrastructure and real ownership, and what they ship is core to our business and our success.

  • Lead and influence, partner with executive leaders to shape the questions and drive the decisions that matter most.

What you'll bring

  • Proven scale-up leadership. You've led data organisations in high-growth tech or SaaS, and you've built this muscle before.

  • Leader of leaders. You've scaled organisations of 40 or more through senior leaders, coached leaders of leaders and hired top talent.

  • Technical excellence and innovation. A data science background combined with analytics and data engineering, and the depth to push what's possible in any direction.

  • Executive leadership. You've owned a data strategy and budget at executive level, made the big build, buy and invest calls, and helped set company direction alongside senior leadership.

  • Modern stack fluency. Fluency across the modern data stack, such as dbt, Snowflake, conversational analytics and Looker or Tableau, plus the instinct to build your own tooling where it gives us an edge.

  • Trust by design. Deep understanding of data privacy, governance and compliance, including GDPR.

  • Partnership at every level. Proven trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Finance and Operations, and the communication skills to influence at the most senior levels and drive alignment.

  • Big picture and fine detail. You move comfortably between company-level strategy and hands-on specifics.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

About Us

We're Team Granola 👋

Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters.

We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on.

About the Role

We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale.

You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow.

  • Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role.

  • Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com, Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business.

  • Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious.

  • Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack.

  • Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security.

  • Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM.

  • Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues.

  • Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful.

  • An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably.

  • A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time.

  • Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use.

  • You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here.

About the Opportunity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

Your role at Veezu:

As a Data Engineer, you'll build and maintain the data platform that powers reporting, analytics and data science across Veezu. Reporting into the Director of Data Engineering, you'll work hands-on with Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python/PySpark and Power BI, bringing data in from our booking systems, databases and third-party APIs and shaping it into trusted, well-modelled datasets that the business relies on every day.

Who are Veezu?

Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!

What you’ll do:

  • Design, build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines in Microsoft Fabric using Pipelines, Notebooks, Lakehouses, Warehouses and OneLake.

  • Write PySpark notebooks to ingest and transform data from SQL Server databases, REST APIs, SaaS applications and file-based exports.

  • Develop and optimise SQL transformations, stored procedures and Kimball-style star-schema data models.

  • Build and support Power BI semantic models and the datasets behind dashboards used by teams across the business.

  • Implement data quality, validation and reconciliation checks so numbers match across systems.

  • Monitor production pipelines and troubleshoot data, performance and refresh issues.

  • Use Git, automated testing and CI/CD to support reliable, repeatable deployments.

  • Maintain clear documentation, data lineage and engineering standards.

  • Work with analysts and business stakeholders to turn requirements into practical data solutions.

  • Be committed to maintaining our ISO27001 certification and set high standards for Information Security compliance.

What you’ll need:

Essential

  • 2-4 years' experience in a data engineering role.

  • Strong SQL skills, including complex transformations and performance tuning.

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (or Azure Synapse / Data Factory and a willingness to move to Fabric).

  • Python and PySpark for data ingestion and transformation.

  • Experience integrating data from APIs and other external sources.

  • Good knowledge of data warehousing and dimensional modelling (Kimball).

  • Experience with Power BI and semantic models.

  • Understanding of data quality, testing and reconciliation, and experience with Git / source control.

  • Confidence communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • CI/CD and automated testing for data pipelines.

  • Microsoft Fabric certification (e.g. DP-600 or DP-700).

  • Lakehouse / medallion architecture design patterns.

  • Experience with data governance, security and lineage.

  • Experience with high-volume transactional data, ideally in transport, mobility or on-demand services.

Where you’ll be:

This role is hybrid, based out of our Cardiff HQ, with 3 days per week in the office.

Veezu is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment, welcoming applications from all backgrounds, experiences, and communities.

We're looking for a Senior Account Executive to own full-cycle new-logo revenue for Cytix's biggest and most complex deals, in a market where most of the people you're calling haven't heard of us yet. You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads who are used to being pitched by categories they already understand.

Your job is to earn a conversation with almost no brand recognition behind you, then run a genuinely consultative sale that gets underneath what a prospect is actually trying to achieve, not just what they say they want.

You'll take on enterprise and partner-adjacent opportunities, competitive procurement, and buying groups that span security, engineering and the economic buyer. You'll also set the bar for the wider sales team: shaping how SDR intake and Customer Success handoff work, and helping newer Account Executives find their feet.

What you'll do

  • Own full-cycle new-logo opportunities from first qualified meeting through discovery, technical evaluation and signature, sourced by SDR, Marketing, partners and your own prospecting.

  • Self-source a meaningful share of your own pipeline; build an account plan from a cold list rather than relying on inbound or SDR support.

  • Run multi-threaded discovery across security, engineering and economic buyers, uncovering pain that a single conversation would miss.

  • Own commercial negotiation, procurement and security review through to signature, including competitive processes, without needing support from the CRO.

  • Maintain an accurate weekly forecast, with commit-to-close accuracy within 10%, sustained over multiple quarters.

  • Shape SDR intake criteria and the Customer Success handoff standard; informally mentor newer Account Executives on deal strategy and technical positioning.

  • Hand off cleanly to Customer Success at close, with deal-stage commitments documented in the CRM.

What you'll bring

  • 5–7+ years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally selling a technical product, not a service, into security or engineering buyers.

  • A demonstrable track record of carrying and hitting quota of £750k–£1m+, at or above 100% in at least two of the last three years.

    Genuine consultative selling skill: comfortable asking why before pitching how, and building a business case from first principles rather than a script.

  • Confidence selling into accounts where Cytix has little or no existing brand presence, building credibility through the conversation itself rather than a logo slide.

  • A track record of pushing through setbacks and coming back stronger, and of actively seeking out the harder, less familiar deals rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Genuinely bright and inquisitive: you ask sharp questions, pick things up fast, and enjoy getting to the bottom of a problem, whether that's a prospect's business or how Cytix's product works under the hood.

  • Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you take ownership of them and lean in, rather than waiting for someone else to sort it out.

  • Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone: new deal types, new buyer personas, situations you haven't fully rehearsed.

What you'll get

  • Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off

  • Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team.

  • A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme.

  • Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover.

  • More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme.

  • Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.

About Cytix

  • Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

  • That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

    We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV.     Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions.     Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

     

    See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

     

    Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

     

    Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

The Role
