Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
  • Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
  • Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
  • Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.
  • Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.
  • Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.
  • Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
  • Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
  • Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment  — not a single product or team's slice of it.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.
  • Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.
  • Strong AWS cloud services background.
  • Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.
  • Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.
  • Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.
  • Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.
  • Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.
  • Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. Belonging at Samsara

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Our mission

Shape the engineering foundations of Mistral AI’s next generation of compute capacity while improving the resilience of the infrastructure already in service. This role combines technical design leadership with field reliability engineering: you will establish demanding, practical requirements for colocation power and cooling, scrutinize proposed solutions and turn operating experience into better designs, safer changes and more reliable AI capacity.

Operating context & accountability

Mistral deploys high-density AI infrastructure in colocation facilities, where partners operate the underlying critical plant. You will be Mistral’s technical counterpart to providers, designers, commissioning specialists and internal IT and capacity teams. The position combines forward-looking design authority with hands-on technical investigation and portfolio reliability improvement. It requires depth in one core engineering discipline and the judgment to lead multidisciplinary decisions with specialist support.

Key responsibilities — design and technical standards

  • Own and continuously improve Mistral’s technical design criteria and colocation requirements for new facilities, expansions and retrofits, including availability objectives, failure domains, maintainability and operational flexibility.

  • Translate GPU platform roadmaps into measurable facility envelopes: IT load and transients, rack density, electrical topology, redundancy, cooling capacity, supply/return temperatures, flow, pressure, water quality and monitoring.

  • Review utility and MV/LV arrangements, transformers, generators, UPS, switchgear, busway, protection coordination, earthing, power quality and metering for suitability under demanding AI loads.

  • Review mechanical and controls architecture, including chilled-water and heat-rejection systems, pumps, control sequences, CDU integration, leak detection, filtration, water treatment and cooling recovery scenarios.

  • Lead multidisciplinary reviews of single-line diagrams, P&IDs, sequences of operation, design calculations, capacity models, failure-mode studies and proposed deviations; document risks and decisions.

  • Participate in site selection, technical due diligence, provider RFPs, design milestones and commercial technical schedules, challenging assumptions before they become delivery constraints.

  • Define design review and exception processes that balance performance, resilience, deployment speed, efficiency, capital cost and long-term operability.

Key responsibilities — commissioning and delivery assurance

  • Partner with delivery and commissioning teams to define functional and integrated testing requirements, acceptance criteria, evidence packages and outstanding-defect management.

  • Validate that electrical and cooling infrastructure can support the contracted AI load envelope under normal, maintenance and credible fault conditions.

  • Review test scripts and results for loss of utility, UPS/generator transitions, cooling component failures, controls faults, CDU interface events and staged restoration where applicable.

  • Ensure operational handover includes accurate drawings, asset and interface registers, monitoring points, setpoints, maintenance constraints, emergency procedures and unresolved risk ownership.

  • Support live-site changes and capacity upgrades with a disciplined review of impact, sequencing, rollback plans and operational readiness.

Key responsibilities — field reliability and root-cause analysis

  • Act as a technical escalation point for recurring or high-impact electrical, mechanical and controls incidents across operational colocation sites.

  • Analyze alarms, BMS/EPMS trends, event sequences, power-quality records, cooling telemetry, commissioning findings and maintenance evidence to distinguish symptoms from systemic causes.

  • Lead or challenge technical root-cause investigations with colocation partners, including common-mode failures, protection miscoordination, thermal instability, control logic, hydraulic performance and hidden capacity limitations.

  • Develop risk-ranked corrective actions and reliability improvement programs; validate effectiveness through evidence and post-change monitoring.

  • Identify fleet-wide patterns and feed lessons learned into reference designs, acceptance tests, technical specifications and provider governance.

  • Review maintenance and change proposals that create material exposure to compute availability, providing clear technical recommendations and escalation where required.

Key responsibilities — collaboration and leadership

  • Work with IT hardware, network and platform teams to understand the operational consequences of rack-level and cluster-level failure domains.

  • Influence colocation providers, consultants and OEM partners through technically rigorous, fact-based reviews without relying on direct operational authority.

  • Present design trade-offs, reliability risks and investment recommendations in language accessible to engineering leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Develop reusable standards, technical playbooks and engineering knowledge sharing to support consistent decisions across a rapidly expanding portfolio.

What success looks like

  • New capacity is accepted against well-defined electrical, thermal and resilience criteria with transparent technical exceptions.

  • Design risks are identified early, reducing late changes, stranded capacity and avoidable operational constraints.

  • Repeat incidents and unresolved critical engineering defects decrease as corrective actions are verified.

  • Field experience produces measurable improvements to future designs and live-site operating resilience.

Minimum qualifications

  • At least 8 years in mission-critical data center design, engineering, commissioning or technical reliability, including responsibility for complex technical decisions.

  • Degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent professional experience, with deep knowledge in one discipline and strong working knowledge of the other.

  • Demonstrated expertise in critical power and cooling architecture, redundancy, failure-mode analysis and operational risk management.

  • Experience reviewing engineering drawings, calculations, commissioning evidence and root-cause analyses, and coordinating technical specialists.

  • Ability to influence colocation providers and cross-functional stakeholders; excellent English communication and willingness to travel.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with AI/HPC infrastructure, high-density accelerator platforms and direct-to-chip liquid cooling.

  • Knowledge of CDUs, facility-to-technology cooling interfaces, hydraulic performance, cooling-water quality and leak management.

  • Experience with electrical protection/selectivity, power quality, controls sequences, integrated systems testing and BMS/EPMS analytics.

  • Experience creating technical standards across multiple sites or providers, including design deviations and fleet-wide reliability improvements.

  • Professional engineering registration or equivalent technical credentials.

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs.

Contexte scientifique :

La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029).

Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données (data centers) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude.

Vecteurs d’innovation, objets de spéculation, instruments de réaffirmation de puissance nationale, leur développement rapide génère aussi de nombreuses inquiétudes, voire du rejet, en France (comme à l’étranger), et ne fait pas à ce jour l’objet d’une planification concertée, mais relève encore largement d’opportunités isolées. Or, ces projets d’infrastructure se trouvent à la croisée d’enjeux locaux, voire hyper-locaux — de l’aménagement territorial aux effets sur l’environnement — et d’enjeux nationaux et internationaux — de la tension sur les réseaux d’électricité aux questions de souveraineté technologique et d’investissement.

Au sein de la Chaire, le ou la post-doctorant(e) étudiera la manière dont les centres de données, objets clés de l’infrastructure numérique, se développent et organisent différents problèmes publics relatifs aux « territoires » à différentes échelles territoriales. Comment en retour, la définition et la hiérarchisation de ces problèmes peuvent permettent des arbitrages concertés pour planifier leur déploiement ?

Les modalités de participation à la construction de ces problèmes publics, autant que la fabrique des données nécessaires pour nourrir les positions des acteurs, sont autant un enjeu de démocratie technique qu’une manière de retrouver prise sur l’aménagement des milieux de vie.

En articulant sociologie des sciences et des techniques et études urbaines avec une méthodologie innovante de recherche-action, TerrAINs contribue à rendre visibles et discutables les infrastructures numériques, tout en expérimentant des outils de représentation des problèmes et de participation, adaptées aux enjeux infrastructurels contemporains.

La Chaire est organisée selon trois axes principaux :

  1. Analyse des discours sur les centres de données, et notamment les discours médiatiques régionaux, nationaux et étrangers ;

  2. Description des modalités du « faire infrastructure » : pratiques situées, relations aux milieux, frictions. Cet axe investira trois sites franciliens concernés par des projets de centres hyperscale.

  3. la chaire est conçue comme un laboratoire de recherche-action qui expérimente de nouvelles modalités de représentation et de participation autour des infrastructures numériques.

The M&A and International Expansion role

Alan is diversifying its activities in the fields of healthcare, prevention and insurance through mergers and acquisitions, and is actively expanding internationally. In addition, Alan recruits talent worldwide and enables its employees to work remotely in complete safety.

“Alaner, everywhere”. The role makes sure each acquisition and each country opening is legally secure, fast and humane: from HR due diligence, to transferring employment contracts, to fully integrating the people who join us.

You'll join the Expansion crew inside the People team. You'll work closely with the crew owner, and with Corporate, Finance, team Leads and General Managers involved in each deal.

The People team

The People team is made up of 13 people who work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every one of them is a genuine fan of our products (Culture being one of them) and deeply committed to Alan's Prevention and Health mission.

The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, Comp and Ben, and now M&A and International Expansion.

It is a generalist team: everyone shares three core missions, namely People on-call (answering the day to day questions from Alaners, which is now AI-powered), individual situation management, and HRBP responsibilities. This represents roughly 50% of our time. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: M&A and expansion.

Your missions

On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a very diverse range of high-impact topics:

You will own to the People workstream of M&A transactions from due diligence to integration, alongside the crew and in close collaboration with the Corporate team, Legal, Finance and the business owners of each deal.

Depending on the nature of the deal, you will own:

  • HR due diligence: reviewing headcount, employment contracts, collective agreements, compensation & benefits, liabilities and risks of target companies, and flagging red flags clearly to the deal team;

  • Transferring employment contracts in France and abroad, and choosing the right path for each deal and country;

  • Integrating acquired teams: day-1 and first-months plans, harmonising contracts and benefits, communicating with acquired employees, onboarding them into Alan's way of working;

  • You will support the people transition of acquired teams, working with the crew and leads on team set-up, keeping key talents, and supporting every individual situation with care;

  • Working with external advisors (law firms, HR advisory, relocation and EoR providers): writing clear briefs and challenging their advice.

Also:

  • Opening new countries on the People side: entity vs employer of record, compliant local contracts, benefits and payroll partners

  • You will handle international relocations and cross-border situations for Alaners moving or working between countries (visas, social security, tax, type of contract);

  • Building reusable playbooks (HR due diligence checklist, integration playbook, "country opening – People" checklist) so each new deal is faster than the last

  • Taking on global and cross-border individual situations (mobility, work from anywhere, sensitive cases)

  • Raising the team's expertise: sharing your knowledge of employment law and M&A practices with the crew and the wider People team

  • Leveraging AI and automation to multiply the impact of your work

By 5 months:

  • You have run, or co-run, one talent density assessment and the parting ways cases that came with it;

  • You handle cross-border individual situations without supervision;

  • Your playbooks are used by the crew and by Legal / Finance on new deals;

  • Leads and crew members come to you as the go-to expert on these topics.

  • You have worked on acquisitions in the Tech industry, not only on very large corporate groups, and you know the method is not the same.

  • You master HR due diligence and the transfer of employment contracts.

  • You have worked on post-merger integration, including talent density and parting ways, not only on the pre-signing side.

  • You have international exposure: you have worked on deals or entities outside France.

  • You are fluent in English, written and spoken (all of our internal processes, documentation and communications are in English).

  • You are adaptable and creative: you adjust your method to each type of company and deal instead of copy-pasting one process.

  • You are very organised: you run several confidential workstreams in parallel without dropping balls.

  • You are a strong communicator, with very different audiences (founders, acquired employees, leads, lawyers), in writing and orally.

  • You are strong technically and can teach us things.

  • You show judgement and discretion with confidential information and sensitive human situations.

Nice-to-have

We are not looking for all of the below. Any one of these can be a strong signal.

  • You have a legal background, ideally in employment law.

  • You have worked in or with a Tech scale-up that made several acquisitions.

  • You have opened entities or set-up employers of record in new countries.

  • You speak another language relevant to our expansion (e.g. Spanish, Portuguese; Arabic).

  • You are AI-enthusiastic and actively use tools to multiply your impact.

Level range

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

Our common vision

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful.

About the role

Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions.

Your responsibilities

Monitor the automation and assure result quality

  • Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness.

  • Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects.

  • Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis.

Assure the quality of results over time

  • Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests.

  • Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks.

  • Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team.

Safeguard data and model quality

  • Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

  • Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early.

  • Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

Automate the operational workflow

  • Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

  • Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

  • Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

The impact you will have

  • Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

  • Issues are caught before customers see them, not after.

  • The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated.

  • Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand.

Your experience and skills

Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social, you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market.

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
  • Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
  • Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
  • Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
  • Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
  • Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
  • Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
  • Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
  • A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
  • Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
  • Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
  • Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Dan is deze stage in nowcasting en econometrie precies wat je zoekt.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Bij het ramen van de kwartaalcijfers van het bbp (economische groei) gebruiken we voor een aantal bedrijfstakken momenteel een relatief eenvoudige methode: de ontwikkeling van het aantal banen dient als benadering voor de economische activiteit. Dit gebeurt omdat directe en tijdige broninformatie ontbreekt. Een belangrijk gevolg hiervan is dat we de eerste ramingen later vaak moeten bijstellen wanneer er meer volledige data beschikbaar komt bij de definitieve raming (ongeveer anderhalf jaar later).

Het is aan jou om deze methodiek te verbeteren.

Je gaat een geavanceerder model ontwikkelen waarmee we de economische activiteit van deze bedrijfstakken kort na afloop van de verslagperiode nauwkeuriger kunnen inschatten. Dit wordt ook wel “nowcasting” genoemd. Het doel is om dichter bij de uiteindelijke realisatie te zitten en daarmee het aantal en de omvang van latere bijstellingen te verkleinen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw opdracht is om te onderzoeken welke databronnen tijdig beschikbaar zijn en we kunnen gebruiken als input voor dit model. Op zoek naar een statistiekstage?
Analyseer bij het CBS weegmethoden en non-respons met R en draag bij aan betere statistieken voor Nederland.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het CBS trekt steekproeven onder de Nederlandse bevolking om diverse statistieken te maken. Hierbij is sprake van selectieve non-respons. Om voor deze non-respons te corrigeren, voeren we een zogenaamde weging uit, waarbij personen een gewicht krijgen op basis van hun onder- of oververtegenwoordiging in de respons. Personen met achtergrondkenmerken die ondervertegenwoordigd zijn in de respons, krijgen dan een groter gewicht dan personen met achtergrondkenmerken die oververtegenwoordigd zijn. Zie bijvoorbeeld [1] voor algemene informatie over wegen.

Bij het uitvoeren van een weging zijn er diverse zaken om rekening mee te houden. Zo kan niet voor alle achtergrondkenmerken worden gecorrigeerd voor scheefheid, omdat de gewichten dan te extreem zouden worden. Daarnaast is het vaak verstandig om überhaupt niet voor te veel achtergrondkenmerken te corrigeren, omdat dit een negatieve invloed heeft op de marges van de schattingen voor de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek. We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering

  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Buildern is the #1 Construction Management Platform, helping residential and commercial builders manage their projects, operations, and finances in one place. We're building the next generation of AI-powered construction management software, enabling construction companies to run smarter, more efficient, and more profitable businesses.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, yet many builders still rely on spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and manual processes to manage their operations. At Buildern, we're changing that.

With a proven product, a growing customer base, and strong momentum, we're looking for an exceptional Founding Account Executive to help accelerate our growth and build a scalable sales function.

This is not a traditional Account Executive role. We're looking for a results-driven, entrepreneurial sales professional who can independently generate opportunities, own the entire sales cycle, and contribute to shaping our go-to-market strategy. Working directly with the Founder & CEO, this person will play a key role in expanding Buildern's market presence and establishing the processes that will support our next stage of growth. This is a role for someone who wants to build a sales engine, not just inherit a pipeline.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, discover, demo, negotiate, and close.
  • Build your own pipeline. Find and engage decision-makers through cold calls, email, and creative outbound strategies.
  • Convert inbound demand. Take ownership of qualified inbound opportunities and turn them into customers.
  • Sell to business owners. Work directly with owners and leaders of established residential construction companies.
  • Run exceptional demos. Understand each prospect's business and show how Buildern can solve their challenges.
  • Build alongside the founder. Help shape our go-to-market strategy, messaging, sales playbook, and processes.
  • Own your numbers. Manage your pipeline, forecast accurately, and consistently deliver revenue.
  • Make us better. Bring insights from the market to improve our product, positioning, and sales approach.

You'll Thrive Here If You...

  • Have proven experience selling construction technology software. This is a must.
  • Are a top-performing B2B SaaS closer with a consistent track record of exceeding quota.
  • Have 5+ years of sales experience, including full-cycle ownership.
  • Know how to generate your own pipeline and don't depend on SDRs or marketing to fill your calendar.
  • Are confident selling directly to construction business owners and decision-makers.
  • Can turn a cold prospect into a paying customer.
  • Know how to run discovery, uncover real business problems, and sell value rather than features.
  • Thrive in early-stage environments where you have ownership, autonomy, and accountability.
  • Are resourceful, competitive, curious, and driven by results.
  • Want to help build something meaningful and share in its success.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have sold construction management, estimating, or project management software to residential builders.
  • Understand the workflows and challenges of custom home building companies.
  • Have experience as a founding or early sales hire.
  • Have helped develop outbound strategies or sales processes from scratch.

Why This Is a Career-Defining Opportunity

  • Build, don't just sell. You'll help define how Buildern acquires customers and scales its sales organization.
  • Work directly with the founder. No layers of management. Your ideas, feedback, and results will have a direct impact.
  • Sell a product that solves real problems. Builders use Buildern to manage critical parts of their businesses, from estimating and scheduling to project finances.
  • Get rewarded for performance. Competitive compensation, uncapped commission, and the opportunity for equity for the right person.
  • Grow with the company. As Buildern scales, you'll have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and potentially grow into a sales leadership role.

We're looking for someone who sees this as more than their next sales job. We want someone who wants to help build the company.

Ready to Build With Us?

If you're a top-performing construction technology AE who can create opportunities, close deals, and wants to help build a leading construction software company, we'd love to hear from you.

Don't just tell us you're great at sales. Show us.

Apply with your resume and a short note about your biggest sales achievement or a deal you sourced and closed yourself.

About SANS

Founded in 1989, SANS Institute (SANS) began as a cooperative research and education organization. Over the next 25 years, it grew to become the most trusted and widely recognized provider of information security training and certification in the world. Today, SANS has served more than 300,000 cybersecurity professionals around the world, with more than 60,000 earning Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) security certifications—the leading certification that provides assurance to employers that their people and prospective hires can do the job.

At the heart of SANS is a community of practitioners, from auditors and network administrators to CISOs, who share their lessons learned and collaborate on solutions to the challenges they face. These experts, working across corporations, government agencies, and universities, come together to support and strengthen the global information security community.

Why SANS?

At SANS, our culture is defined by three pillars: Mission, Brand, and People.

  • Our Mission is to hire people who understand the importance fighting against cybersecurity threats.
  • Our Brand reflects a commitment to delivering the highest quality training.
  • Our People are grounded in a culture of fairness, honesty, customer focus, and a pragmatic approach.

What You'll Achieve at SANS

We are seeking a Social Media Manager to join our Marketing - Brand & Communication team. This role plays a key part in owning the day-to-day execution of organic social content and channels, with community management, social listening, and crisis escalation at the center of the role, alongside digital copywriting, staying ahead of platform algorithm changes to protect organic reach, employee advocacy, regional and affiliated channel support, and discoverability and reporting work, all aimed at growing brand awareness, expanding qualified reach, and supporting course and certification demand. It's a chance to help shape SANS's presence with the cybersecurity community it trains, owning the day-to-day work of community engagement and channel execution.

As a Social Media Manager, you will:

  • Create, test, and monitor organic social media content across all current and emerging SANS channels and formats, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, YouTube, and Reddit, and spanning short-form video (Reels, Shorts, TikTok), carousels/document posts, polls, and other formats as they emerge, to support marketing promotions, increase awareness of our courses and certifications, and grow our follower base
  • Apply SANS content and brand voice standards consistently across all managed channels.
  • Own community management across all SANS social channels, including responding to inquiries, moderating conversations, and building relationships with the community
  • Conduct social listening to deepen engagement and trust with our target audience and the broader security community.
  • Optimize and measure channel performance using social analytics and reporting, identifying what content is most effective at growing our list, driving qualified visitors to our course pages, and driving revenue attainment, and using this data to guide content decisions and demonstrate impact to stakeholders
  • Manage the day-to-day posting cadence on SANS social media channels.
  • Produce and manage employee advocacy content through Sociabble, including first-person post copy, content calendars, and faculty / employee adoption efforts.
  • Work closely with our B2C and B2B Campaign and Field Marketing managers to deploy and manage social media campaigns per region/sub-region
  • Support global and regional affiliated brand channel management in coordination with relevant business unit and geo.
  • Support dedicated country / regional channel launches and ongoing management, including content calendar coordination with field marketing and campaign managers.
  • Keeping abreast of new social media technologies, digital marketing trends and implementing these new technologies into our activities
  • Support content discoverability efforts (SEO / AEO / GEO) as they relate to organic social content
  • Working with Content, Creative Services and Product Marketing Manager teams to develop engaging social media content and analyzing content success
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

Every SANS employee brings something unique. For this role, we’re looking for candidates with:

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.A.), with an emphasis in Marketing discipline preferred
  • 3 - 5 years of proven experience in organic social media marketing and content development and campaign management, including experience developing strategic community engagement (social listening)
  • Strong understanding of native content formats across platforms (polls, document/carousel posts, Reels, Shorts) and how format choice affects reach and engagement
  • An aptitude for customer care, corporate communications, collaboration and community building
  • Ability to translate social listening insights into actionable recommendations for content, campaigns, or crisis response
  • Experience reporting on social media KPIs and communicating performance insights to senior stakeholders
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing communications strategies and messaging across various social media channels, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, YouTube, and Reddit
  • Unrestricted authorization to work in the USA; visa sponsorship is not available.

Preferred qualifications include:

  • Excellent understanding of social trends, community, reporting and organic tactics
  • Experience building, executing and scaling social-first marketing programs
  • Experience distilling social data and insights into actionable strategies that inform business goals
  • Strong presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Direct experience using social media management tools such as Sprout Social, and Buffer
  • Experience with Asana or similar project management tools for content calendar and task tracking
  • Familiarity with employee advocacy platforms, i.e., Sociabble or similar
  • Familiarity with AI tools to streamline content creation, scheduling, and reporting workflows
  • Experience using web analytics tools, in particular, Google Analytics, Tableau
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills
  • Preference for specific experience in B2B and cybersecurity products/services
  • A creative problem solver that is comfortable initiating new ideas, strategies
  • A start-up mentality, high sense of urgency as well as an ability to interface with multiple team members to ensure goals are met/aligned
  • A pro-active forward-thinking team player – collaborative and cross-functional team member, able to multitask and get input from multiple other professionals

Benefits and Perks of Working at SANS

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation. The expected salary range for this position is $80,000 - $90,000, depending on geographic location, skills, and experience. At SANS, pay equity and transparency are priorities.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your total well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

  • Financial Benefits: Competitive base salary, bonus opportunities, and a 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Health & Wellness: Robust medical, dental, and vision plans; company-provided short term disability; optional long-term disability, supplemental life and AD&D insurance for employees and dependents; voluntary benefits including accident insurance and identity theft protection; fitness and wellness programs; and a company paid employee assistance program (EAP).
  • Time Off & Flexibility: Generous paid time off, including volunteer time.
  • Learning & Development: Access to professional development and SANS training opportunities.

Flexibility and Balance at SANS

We support our colleagues with the tools and flexibility they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. As a primarily remote work environment, we are committed to maintaining strong connections, collaboration, and a vibrant culture across virtual teams. While most roles operate remotely, some positions may require occasional in-person presence depending on role-specific or business needs.

SANS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

SANS is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, or to perform the essential functions of a position, please contact SANS Human Resources.

US Job Seekers: Click here to view the “Know Your Rights” poster.

SANS complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding the consideration of applicants with arrest or conviction records. For positions governed by federal and/or state banking regulations, SANS will adhere to relevant requirements when evaluating candidates with criminal histories.

Employment eligibility in the United States is required. SANS does not provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Salary: $80,000-90,000

Overview

Quest is an award-winning IT management software provider offering a broad selection of solutions that solve some of the most common and most challenging IT problems. Quest strives to be the best of the very best in everything we do. We are fanatically customer-focused and are proud to support the most complex customers who have the highest IT demands in the world. It’s exciting, it’s rewarding, it’s hard work, and offers career and personal growth.

At Quest Software, we build technology that simplifies IT management and strengthens cybersecurity resilience for organizations around the world. Our people are central to our success, and we are committed to delivering an HR experience that reflects our global footprint, growth mindset, and employee-first culture.

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Quest, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring customers realize maximum value from their investments through comprehensive adoption and value engagements. The CSM will manage a portfolio of accounts and lead engagement throughout the customer lifecycle—from deployment and adoption through value realization and renewal—ensuring satisfaction and long-term success. You’ll leverage your expertise to guide customers through their journey, maintain consistent engagement, and ensure they achieve their goals and derive measurable value from Quest solutions. You’ll also surface Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) and coordinate with Account Management for follow-up. CSMs support renewal contracting processes and are expected to stay informed on Quest’s evolving product portfolio, demonstrating the ability to quickly learn and communicate the value of new offerings.

-Proactively manages named accounts and is accountable for engagement and satisfaction over the lifetime of the customer

-Establishes relationships with the customer key stakeholders, ensuring regular check-ins to understand and promptly address client needs and concerns

-Develops and maintains strategic Success Plans that align with value milestones and customer-defined business outcomes

-Partners with the customer to build a joint plan for success, maintaining a detailed understanding of the customer’s business to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction, engagement, and adoption of Quest technologies

-Monitors customer analytics and KPIs to reinforce the value of the customer solution, identify areas to improve customer experience, and optimize the solution

-Facilitates Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) in collaboration with Account Management, using the Success Plan and business case to demonstrate impact, value delivered, and growth opportunities

-Delivers an outstanding customer experience to support our brand promise of delivering superior outcomes and to support and identify cross-sell and upsell of services and products

-Actively monitors customer engagement signals and sentiment; logs risks and opportunities in CRM and triggers internal playbooks where applicable

-Supports collaboration across Sales, Support, Product, Renewals, and Professional Services to ensure continuity and strategic alignment

-Acts as an escalation point for high-impact customer issues when necessary, ensuring appropriate teams within Quest are engaged for quick resolution

-Works within the wider CSM team to implement scalable programs and process improvements to drive efficiency of internal customer success processes and improve customer experience

-Minimum of 3 years of experience in customer success role responsible for driving customer success and product/service adoption

-Minimum of 3 years of experience in customer management within platform management and security solutions, focusing on growth, adoption, retention, and issue resolution at both the business owner and senior executive levels

-Excellent organizational skills and ability to establish milestones and keep success plans on task

-Adept at handling internal and external escalations

-Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships, and comfortable facilitating change and being accountable for driving success with customers

-Experience in leading, adopting, and driving change internally or externally

-Experience in identifying, translating, and prioritizing customer issues and needs into business or solution requirements

-Demonstrated success as a trusted advisor to senior executives in large organizations and ability to build success plans

-An understanding of how organizations measure value realization and drive revenue. Experience in recurring revenue sales models and renewal processes is an advantage

-Must be located within the United States

-Experience in transformational Customer Success projects or experience where products shift from On-Premise to SaaS

-Previous Customer Success experience in a company with B2B Software

-Proficiency in customer success tools (e.g., Gainsight, Totango) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) to manage customer health, success plans, and engagement tracking. Experience with AI prompting and leveraging AI tools to streamline processes

Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. More than 45,000 companies — including 90% of the Fortune 500 — trust Quest to solve their most critical IT challenges. From securing identities and modernizing platforms to preparing data for AI, we help enterprises unlock their full potential.

Why Quest

At Quest, your work makes an impact. You’ll help organizations get AI-ready while building your career with a global team of innovators. We offer:

  • Competitive pay, annual bonuses, and top-performer recognition.
  • Comprehensive health, family, and retirement benefits.

  • Lead regional team of order forecasting specialists focused on taking customer promotion, new product launch, store opening / closing, holiday and other special circumstance or specific weekly plans and translate that into volume modifications and exception information for frontline ordering.

  • Provides inputs to DSDE Technology team members, technical staff as needed to identify, outline, and collaborate on potential enhancements, corrections and adjustments of forecasting algorithm and system software or communication technologies to better achieve growth, freshness and route operations.   • Support system maintenance to ensure accurate representation and operation of route configurations, store, scheduling and product alignment.

About the Company and Role

HousingWire is the most trusted source for news, data, and insights in the housing market. Through its media, data, events, and performance intelligence platforms, HousingWire helps housing professionals make better decisions, faster.

HousingWire Data powers one of the most extensive real estate and housing datasets across the nation, capturing high-frequency, real-time housing market activity and translating it into capabilities across the HousingWire platform – as well as powering clients to build data-driven businesses.

The Senior Solutions Engineer will work with internal teams and clients to help develop the data solutions business line. Every serious deal involves a technical evaluation — match-rate tests, schema reviews, security questionnaires, licensing negotiations. Right now that work lands on AEs and data engineering. The Solutions Engineer will own this process – working closely with data and client teams to win more deals and improve the product suite and delivery systems.

What you'll do

Win the deal

  • Get in front of prospects early and figure out what they actually need. Work with Sales to run evaluations and define success criteria.
  • Know our delivery options cold (API, data share, bulk) and be direct about which one fits and which one doesn't.
  • Work through licensing and compliance issues with finance and sales before they become deal blockers.

Take care of clients

  • When a customer signs, you don't hand them off. You see it through – credentials, schema mapping, backfill, reconciliation, the whole thing.
  • Be the person they call when something breaks or doesn't look right. Get to the bottom of it before looping in engineering.
  • Set clients up to move on their own—good documentation, working examples, and sandbox access so they're not waiting on us for every step.

Build something that lasts

  • Write the frameworks, templates, and tools that make the next evaluation faster and more predictable than the last one.
  • Put together the documentation customers actually need: what the data is, where it comes from, what it doesn't cover, and how to use it.
  • Know the competitive landscape well enough to have an honest conversation about where we win and where we don't.
  • When we lose a deal or a customer hits a wall, make sure that signal gets back to product in a way that's specific and actionable.

Who you are

The right team member will have the unique ability to jump between multiple responsibilities with grace – holding a sales conversation, running a live data evaluation, getting a customer to production, and writing the process playbook to scale this business line.

You're also someone clients genuinely like working with because you add value and build relationships.

You'll need

  • At least 5 years in a sales engineering or similar client-facing technical role—specifically selling data, not just software.
  • Strong SQL and enough Python to do real work with a prospect file on the spot.
  • Experience carrying technical deals through the full cycle—discovery to close—at six figures and above.
  • The ability to walk into a client conversation with no warm-up and leave with their trust and a clear next step.
  • Writing that people actually want to read. You'll produce a lot of it.

Helpful but not required

  • You've been the first or second SE at a company before.
  • You know US real estate or mortgage data—assessor/recorder records, deeds, liens, MLS, AVMs, parcel data, foreclosure pipelines.
  • You've worked inside Snowflake data sharing, Databricks Delta Sharing, or similar at real scale.
  • You've sat on the customer side—at a lender, servicer, SFR shop, PropTech company, or carrier.

Compensation & benefits

  • Position level: Individual contributor.
  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and ancillary coverage options.
  • Unlimited PTO plus Paid Parental Leave.
  • Hybrid/remote work options, depending on location
Salary: 110,000-120,000 OTE

This Senior Underwriter for the Brokerage Casualty team will determine acceptability of individual risk, pricing, coverage, terms & conditions for the Primary Casualty line of business. E&S/S underwriting experience preferred.



Job Description Summary

Are you a critical thinker who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As a Senior Underwriter in Brokerage Casualty you will determine individual risk acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions, by developing, analyzing and evaluating information and exposures on risks of moderate technical complexity for the Primary Casualty line of business. You will achieve production and loss ratio goals within assigned brokers and program managers by reviewing and analyzing claims, loss history and taking appropriate action on accounts. Within defined parameters, you may be responsible for determining appropriate reinsurance placement, if any, on individual risks. We will count on you to foster positive business relationships with brokers and reinsurers.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviews individual risks with assigned brokers and either declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. Analyzes exposure to loss, develops an adequate premium charge for the exposure, determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract.

  • Achieves team/individual production and loss ratio goals with assigned brokers through sound broker management and marketing. Continually analyzes premium and loss results with assigned brokers by state, major class of business, etc. Continually assesses quality of broker submissions and makes corrective action recommendations.

  • Handles policy maintenance items and other mid-term requests. Reviews endorsement requests and processes necessary changes to the policy. Reviews loss control reports and makes recommendations to the broker and/or changes to the policy. Follows up on outstanding information as required. Reviews claim activity and takes appropriate action.

  • Within defined parameters may place reinsurance per department guidelines based upon the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty, semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Maintains good working relationship with re-insurers.

  • Fosters positive business relationships with brokers, through frequent contact. Develops and maintains good rapport and resolves broker conflicts. Travels to broker offices as required for training or marketing visits. Entertains brokers visiting the Company as required. Assists with development of marketing ideas and strategies for Underwriting events and other marketing campaigns.

  • Proactively develops technical and business knowledge through internal and external venues.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Underwriting Manager. No direct reports.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate studies preferred and/or equivalent work experience.

CTS seeks a Schedule Analyst Subject Matter Expert to provide technical expertise to the Evaluations, Assessments, Studies, Services, and Support (EASSS) contract. This contract supports NASA Headquarters Science Mission Directorate (SMD) and facilitates NASA’s pursuit of the most noteworthy approaches for missions, payloads, spacecraft, instruments, and research that help answer the big questions in Earth and Space science. Located at LaRC, the NASA’s Science Office for Mission Assessments (SOMA) helps SMD select and manage missions, spacecraft, and instruments. To accomplish this, SOMA manages and provides oversight of evaluations, assessments, and studies for SMD and other NASA organizations. These include evaluation of proposals received in response to NASA Announcements of Opportunity, NASA Research Announcements, Cooperative Agreement Notices, and Broad Agency Announcements, as well as highly specialized studies and assessments, such as life cycle and independent cost estimates, schedule assessments, and risk analyses. CTS supports SOMA via the EASSS contract by providing subject matter experts who will apply their expertise to complex proposal evaluations, management and technical assessments, and advanced studies through the EASSS contract.

CTS’s subject matter experts need not be local to the program office near NASA Langley Research Center in Hampton, VA. We seek individuals who bring significant Technical, Management and Cost expertise in missions, payloads, spacecraft and instruments relevant to NASA’s mission. The work is performed remotely with less than 10% travel occurring periodically for some during the assignment to bring the geographically distributed teams together for workshops to finalize results.

The Schedule Analysis evaluators shall have demonstrated knowledge and proficiency in generating and maintaining NASA spaceflight mission schedules through all development phases. Evaluators shall be proficient in utilizing Microsoft Project to analyze schedule metrics such as critical path, secondary critical paths, and schedule margin. Evaluators shall be familiar with the NASA Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Handbook and have experience assessing schedule completeness across WBS elements.

Education: Must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Finance, Engineering, or other directly related field.

We thank you for your time and consideration of our current opening. If you choose to apply please be sure to upload your most recent and detailed resume for our review.

Provides statistical support for all phases of clinical development. As a top 500 Amazon storefront and a data-driven company, we analyze consumer and market trends to mitigate risk and maximize performance for our brand partners.

Neato is a well-capitalized late-stage startup ranked 39th on Inc. Magazine's Fastest Growing Companies in America. We're scaling fast and building the team to match.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Project Management Systems Support Specialist to help keep Neato's project management system healthy. monday.com is the operational backbone of the business, touching every department. When something breaks, you fix it. When there's spare capacity, you partner with our PM Systems Specialist on new workflows, automations, and system builds.

This is a part-time contract role. Bug fixes and maintenance come first. Build support comes second. You're not a project manager, you're a systems person who knows monday.com deeply and can move quickly on the operational plumbing that keeps everyone else's work flowing.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

✓Fix bugs fast — triage and resolve monday.com issues as they come in from teams across the business.

✓Repair broken automations — track down misfiring notifications, stalled workflows, and integrations that stop working as expected.

✓Adjust boards on request — update columns, statuses, views, and configurations as team needs shift.

✓ Communicate directly — respond to the person who raised the issue in their own words, not just through emoji triggers, automations, or status changes. Every inquiry has a human on the other end who needs to know they've been heard.

✓Keep the system tidy — flag stale boards, cluttered views, and unused automations for cleanup.

✓Document what you fix — capture what broke, how you resolved it, and why, so the team builds shared understanding over time.

✓Support the build roadmap — when the fix queue is clear, partner with the PM Systems Specialist on new workflows, automations, and templates.

✓Prototype and test — build automation logic in a sandbox before rolling changes out to the wider team.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

✓Fast response — bug reports and change requests get triaged and resolved quickly, without teams having to chase.

✓Reliable system — teams trust that boards, notifications, and automations do what they're supposed to.

✓Fewer repeat issues — the same problems don't come back because fixes address the root cause, not the symptom.

✓Documented work — changes and fixes are logged so the PM Systems team can see what's happening without asking.

✓Build velocity — when partnering on new builds, projects move faster because you're picking up real execution work.

WHAT YOU BRING

✓Deep monday.com expertise — hands-on experience configuring boards, building automations, and troubleshooting issues in a production environment. No hand-holding needed.

✓Strong problem-solving instincts — you can look at a broken workflow and figure out what's actually wrong, not just what's visible.

✓Excellent communication — you can write a clear bug diagnosis, ask sharp scoping questions, and coordinate with people across the business.

✓ Customer-service mindset — treat every internal team like a customer. Follow up, close the loop, and never leave someone wondering where their request stands.

✓Self-directed — you get direction and run with it. You don't wait for check-ins to move.

✓Reliable schedule — part-time doesn't mean flexible whenever. We'll agree on availability and expect you to hit it.

✓Detail-oriented — you catch small issues before they become big ones.

NICE TO HAVE

★Integrations experience — monday.com integrations with Slack, Google Workspace, webhooks, or the monday API.

★Ops or PM support background — prior experience supporting a project management or operations function in a growing company.

Neato · 2026 · Equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Salary: Part Time/ 20 Hours per week
